connection_condition: question posts are the subset of post rows whose post type code is 1
description: A question is a specific kind of post; its value domain is a subset of the post value domain.

connection_condition: answer posts are the subset of post rows whose post type code is 2
description: An answer is a specific kind of post; its value domain is a subset of the post value domain.

connection_condition: post rows carry an owner user identifier that corresponds to a user identifier in the user table; the owner identifier is null for some posts
description: A post is owned by a user, but a post is not a component of a user and a user is not a kind of post, so the connection is a general business association.

connection_condition: comment rows carry the identifier of the post they are attached to
description: A comment is a component part of a post discussion and cannot meaningfully exist without its post.

connection_condition: comment rows carry an author user identifier corresponding to a user identifier
description: A comment is written by a user; the comment is not part of the user record.

connection_condition: vote rows carry the identifier of the post they apply to
description: A vote is an event attached to a post and has no meaning without that post.

connection_condition: some vote rows carry an acting user identifier; most do not
description: A vote may be cast by a user, recorded as a general association because the acting user is frequently anonymous.

connection_condition: badge award rows carry the awarded user identifier
description: A badge award belongs to a user and is meaningless without the awarded account.

connection_condition: revision rows carry the identifier of the post they revise
description: A revision event is a component part of a post's history and cannot exist without the post.

connection_condition: revision rows carry the identifier of the user who performed the revision
description: A revision event is performed by a user; the event is not part of the user record.

connection_condition: tag names appear as angle-bracket-delimited tokens inside the post tag text rather than through a foreign key
description: Tags label posts topically; because no identifier link exists between the tag catalogue and posts, this is a general association.

connection_condition: badge award rows are counted per awarded user
description: Badge award count is derived by counting badge award records for each user.

connection_condition: matching post rows are counted against the comparison post population
description: Percentage share is derived from counts of the rows that form the population and its matching subset.

connection_condition: the recorded action name repeats the user display name but is frequently blank
description: Both concepts express a user's display name; one is a point-in-time snapshot stored on the action row, the other is the account's current name.

connection_condition: elder users are the subset of user rows whose recorded age exceeds 65
description: An elder user is a specific user segment; its value domain is a subset of the user value domain.

connection_condition: title-kind revision rows repeat the title of the post at that revision, including wording that differs from the current title
description: Revision text is an alternative record of a post's title over time rather than the current title value.

connection_condition: the owner concept is grounded in an owner user identifier on post rows that corresponds to a user identifier; absent when the account is not linked
description: The post owner role resolves to a user account, but the owner is a role played by a user rather than a kind of user or a part of the post.

connection_condition: last-editor user identifiers on post rows correspond to user identifiers
description: The last editor is a user account credited with the most recent edit of a post.
